## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复 Codex 长对话的分段记录被误标为同 ID 文件冲突。依据当前客户端数据库的唯一有效记录打开当前分段，保留全部原文件；无法确认当前版本时继续提示核对。
- 会话来源中的“受管客户端”改为“默认 Codex 目录”并增加说明。空的默认目录不再占据会话来源选项；已有会话的目录继续显示，来源会话数不受标题筛选影响。
- 为分段历史增加单会话复制、ZIP 导入导出及同步保护，避免截断或错误合并。需要迁移完整分段会话时，请在实例页面使用“复制实例”。

- Fixed native paginated Codex conversations being incorrectly reported as conflicting same-ID files. A unique valid record in the active client database identifies the current segment; all original files are retained. Unresolved versions remain protected.
- Renamed the default client directory and added an explanation. Empty default directories are hidden from session source choices; populated directories remain available, with source counts independent of title filters.
- Added safeguards for paginated history in individual-session copying, ZIP import/export and synchronization to prevent truncation or incorrect merging. Use “Copy instance” on the Instances page to transfer complete segmented conversations.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。安装前停止实例并退出旧管理器；账号、实例与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Stop instances and quit the old manager before installing; accounts, instances and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

当前支持 Codex。Claude Code、Claude Desktop 及其他客户端仍为计划接入。客户端需单独安装；界面兼容与 Fast 的实际支持取决于客户端、模型和供应商。

Codex is currently supported. Claude Code, Claude Desktop and other clients remain planned integrations. Clients must be installed separately; UI compatibility and Fast depend on the client, model and provider.

源码对应标签 [`v0.4.3`](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.4.3)，安装包校验值见附件 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

Source corresponds to tag [`v0.4.3`](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.4.3); installer checksums are in the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
